items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: We played together too... We played, he played lots of jobs with our band.

ctx.x: So, when Paul was getting ready to leave the band, they sent for me, you see? In fact, Paul told me, they want me to work with people on the band, because he's going to leave and go make up a band with Sonny Allen and, uh, Sonny Allen and Walter Pichon, and they call it the Pelican Silvertone, obviously.
That's Sonny Allen. That'd be Red Allen.
